card.name: OF in the keep-out-of-reach warning
card.fires_on: The word OF in the capitalised warning KEEP (THIS PRODUCT) OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. Also a hyphen or letter joining a prefix to a following word, as in spring-m(echanism) or 5-m(icron).

modes.label: The keep-out-of-reach warning
modes.description: The word OF right after KEEP OUT in the child-safety warning.
modes.example: KEEP OUT<< OF>> REACH OF CHILDREN.

modes.label: Hyphen or letter in compound
modes.description: An m after a hyphen, or a single letter, in a compound technical term.
modes.example: The possibility of mounting a KMT-6 anti<<-m>>ine system was also added.

card.plain: It responds to the word OF in the standard warning that a product be kept out of children's reach, and to some hyphenated compounds.
